notes: One record for Microsoft's four Catawba County data centers under one incentive package (WSOC: four new data centers, a 10-year project; Hoodline, citing the Charlotte Observer, lists campuses in Conover, Hickory, Maiden and Newton, Nov.-Dec. 2025 commercial permits worth about $909M, and an incentive guarantee of at least $1B over 10 years). Microsoft slowed some work in April 2025 (WSOC) and resumed after about 10 months (Hoodline, Feb. 2026). Town set to Conover (the site WSOC visited). Split into separate records if official addresses turn up. Promoted from lead nc-catawba-microsoft. Separate from Microsoft's Person County record. Pass 3 (2026-10-15): Split. Microsoft's North Carolina page lists three Catawba construction sites with separate locations: Lyle Creek ('greater Conover area near Highway 16'; Sept 2026 update: building exterior in final stages, interior, mechanical and electrical work under way), Stover (near the Hickory-Lincolnton Highway, Newton address; new record nc-catawba-microsoft-stover) and Boyd Farm (off Zeb Haynes Road, Maiden; new record nc-catawba-microsoft-boyd-farm). This record now stands for Lyle Creek (Conover). The $1B figure is the whole Catawba package (all sites), not Lyle Creek alone. WSOC counted four data centers; Microsoft's page names three.
